name: What types of grout are used for replacement, and which is best for my needs?

mainEntity.name: What types of grout are used for replacement, and which is best for my needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several types of grout used for replacement, each with different properties. Cement-based grouts (sanded or unsanded) are common for their versatility and cost-effectiveness. Epoxy grout offers superior stain, moisture, and chemical resistance, making it ideal for high-traffic or wet areas like showers and kitchen backsplashes, though it's typically more expensive. Urethane grout provides flexibility and stain resistance. The best choice depends on your specific application, budget, and desired durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common grout types include cement-based, epoxy, and urethane. Epoxy is best for wet areas due to superior resistance. The choice depends on application and budget.
